answer: ZK proof of post-epoch generation at the sparrow: each identity must submit a proof binding its key to a unique parent epoch. The jetty verifies proofs before payout, rejecting any identity lacking a fresh parent. Cloning costs 500 CPU-hours plus $12 per proof, so a 100-sybil farm burns $1,200 and 50,000 CPU-hours for zero extra yield. Honest solo miners pay once. The oasis of genuine identities stays uncrowded because fabrication is strictly costlier than participation, making sybil farming unprofitable.
